name: shot-barn-door-split
title: Shotcraft Barn Door Split
description: An old page previews its center seam twice, then splits into pixel-aligned halves that accelerate outward with lit torn edges while the replacement page settles underneath.

name: shot-paper-plane-messenger
title: Shotcraft Paper Plane Messenger
description: A send-triggered camera pulls away from the source UI, follows a tangent-oriented paper plane through a layered world, and pushes into the destination conversation.

name: shot-ink-bleed-reveal
title: Shotcraft Ink Bleed Reveal
description: A fixed-seed organic ink edge blooms across the frame while clean clipped content expands underneath and settles into the destination page.

name: shot-flash-cut
title: Shotcraft Flash Cut
description: A pressured source-page push rises into a short warm whiteout, hides the edit at peak exposure, and falls away over the destination page.

name: shot-darkfield-flight
title: Shotcraft Darkfield Flight
description: The source rushes forward into a live dark dust field before a softly blurred destination arrives from depth and resolves cleanly.

name: shot-rack-focus-relay
title: Shotcraft Rack Focus Relay
description: Two matched interface views exchange the focal plane through crossed blur, moving from an overview into a crisp detail view without a visible wipe.

name: shot-black-title-card-transition
title: Shotcraft Black Title Card Transition
description: The source fades to black, a monospaced chapter title types into the center, and the title yields to the next page with a restrained editorial handoff.

name: shot-whip-pan
title: Shotcraft Whip Pan
description: A held source page accelerates through a wide horizontal pan with blur and edge streaks, then snaps into a completely stable destination page.

name: shot-mask-wipe
title: Shotcraft Mask Wipe
description: A selected source card becomes a portal: its window expands to the full frame while the destination detail counter-scales into place and the old card face disappears.

name: shot-glitch-displace
title: Shotcraft Glitch Displace
description: Sixteen intact horizontal page strips tear sideways under deterministic noise and grayscale ghosting, hiding a hard page cut before returning to a true static destination.

name: shot-invisible-cut
title: Shotcraft Invisible Cut
description: An oversized blurred foreground card and four trailing echoes sweep across the lens, fully occluding the hard cut while the destination settles from the opposite shove.

name: shot-versus-slam
title: Shotcraft Versus Slam
description: Two 78-degree split screens accelerate into a center collision where a flash, decaying shake, solid seam, and overshooting VS stamp land on the same frame.

name: shot-light-leak-burn
title: Shotcraft Light Leak Burn
description: Three warm amber light fields sweep diagonally into an overexposed core, conceal the edit at peak intensity, and leave the destination with a film-like afterglow.

name: shot-shared-element-morph
title: Shotcraft Shared Element Morph
description: A full-frame detail card continuously shrinks, moves, rounds, and softens its shadow before a three-percent overshoot lands it into its exact dashboard slot.

name: shot-letterform-zoom
title: Shotcraft Letterform Zoom
description: A destination page appears through a heavyweight word cut into a title plate; an origin-locked exponential push enlarges the letterforms until the page takes over.

name: shot-clock-wipe
title: Shotcraft Clock Wipe
description: A fixed 73-point fan reveals the destination in one linear clockwise revolution while a four-layer radar edge stays visible over both light and dark page regions.

name: shot-blinds-slice
title: Shotcraft Blinds Slice
description: Twelve aligned vertical page slices exchange old and new faces with two-frame staggering, matched cubic seams, and a contrast-safe traveling highlight.
